//: agent-memory hooks for Claude Code. hooks/agent-memory/install.sh merges this into ~/.claude/settings.json (or merge it manually). Requires the adapter symlink ~/.claude/hooks/agent-memory.py -> <repo>/hooks/agent-memory/agent_memory.py. The permissions.allow rules let Claude read/update its working-state file without prompting. SessionStart covers startup, resume, /clear and post-compaction re-injection; UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse journal activity; PostToolUse also delivers the mid-turn staleness nudge (never to Task subagents, whose payloads carry agent_id/agent_type); Stop enforces checkpoint freshness; PreCompact/SessionEnd record lifecycle. Also merge snippets/instructions.snippet.md into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (the durable ingest half).
